infotexts.entitydescription.mka_ifak: IFAK (Individual First Aid Kit): a small first aid pouch for every crew member. Holds medical supplies only and fits in a backpack, a toolbelt or a uniform. Can be placed inside containers.
infotexts.entitydescription.mka_medkit: A standard medic's kit. Holds medical supplies only. Can be attached to medical uniform and opened directly from it.
infotexts.entitydescription.mka_traumabag: A large emergency bag that has to be carried with both hands. Holds plenty of medical supplies, and nothing else. Not waterproof: it falls apart if left in water for too long.
infotexts.entitydescription.mka_traumabag_waterpro: A hard-shell, waterproof trauma case that has to be carried with both hands. Holds a little less than a regular trauma bag, but keeps its contents dry and doesn't degrade in water. Holds medical supplies only.
infotexts.entitydescription.mka_largemedicalbag: A roomy medic's bag, carried in one hand or kept in the inventory. Holds medical supplies only.
